answer_1.quote: Our model generates candidate polar questions, arguably the most common form of clarification in dialogue, by applying rule-based linguistic transformations to the outputs of a pretrained image captioner.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate these models on a total of 1,000 games sampled from each dataset using contexts of size k = 10 images.

answer_4.quote: We recruited a total of 40 participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to play 10 games each.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were prompted to give either a 'yes', 'no', or 'N/A' response to each question.
